SharedMap.title: Shared Map State
SharedMap.description: Represents the serializable state of a map view for sharing.

subject.description: The user-defined subject or title of the shared map.

url.description: The base URL of the OGC server.

wmsStyleEnabled.description: Whether the WMS style is active.

baseLayerId.description: The ID of the active base layer.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the map was shared. This will be a server timestamp object.

UserMap.title: User Map
UserMap.description: A map saved by an authenticated user in their personal library.

userId.description: The UID of the map owner.
